summary.name: TokenMeter
summary.one_liner: A macOS menu bar app that tracks Claude Code usage, including live rate limits, API-equivalent costs, and activity heatmaps.
use_cases: monitor Claude Code rate limit usage
track daily and monthly AI coding spend
get alerted before hitting Claude usage limits
see which Claude models consume the most tokens
review coding activity patterns over time
summary.what_it_does: TokenMeter shows live utilization percentages from the Anthropic API for session and weekly rate limit windows, with reset countdowns. It sends macOS notifications when usage reaches 80% of the rate limit, throttled to avoid spam. It provides API-equivalent cost breakdowns for today, this week, and this month, with per-model pricing and a per-model breakdown of tokens and costs for Opus, Sonnet, and Haiku. It also includes an hour-by-day activity heatmap covering 7, 14, or 30 days, and refreshes automatically every 5 minutes.
notable: Lives in the macOS menu bar with no dock icon and works in fullscreen
Shows live session and weekly rate limit utilization from the Anthropic API
Installable via Homebrew (brew install Priyans-hu/tap/tokenmeter) or curl, no Xcode required
Listed in awesome-mac under AI Tools as open-source software
caveats: Costs are API-equivalent estimates, not actual billing amounts
Requires Keychain access on first launch to authorize usage data
